# Quickstart

> Make your first request in a few minutes.

## Create an API key

1. Open **API Keys** in the console.
2. Click **+ New key**.
3. Copy the key. The console shows it **only once**.

Set `max_results` to limit how many results come back. Use the [search filters](https://docs.example.com/filters.md) to narrow them.

> [card] [Search API](https://docs.example.com/search.md)
>
> Ranked results for any query.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `search_type` | Which kind of search to run. Defaults to standard. |
